name: English
title: Europe Atlas
sub: Open dataset on all 50 European countries (JSON): population by gender, GDP, PPP GDP, languages, currency and time zones, ready for data analysis.
missing: Tip not translated yet: contribute on GitHub!
foot: Rounded, approximate figures (2024 orders of magnitude). GDP in USD billions, PPP GDP in international dollars. 'Languages' = living languages recorded. 50 countries: the 44 UN-listed European states plus Kosovo (partially recognised), Cyprus, Türkiye, Georgia, Armenia and Azerbaijan. Time zone: the second value is summer time. Check official travel advisories before you go. Data CC BY 4.0, code MIT.

tips.gb: Drive on the left. An electronic travel authorisation (ETA) is required for most visa-free visitors, Europeans included.
tips.ie: Outside Schengen: Common Travel Area with the UK. Drive on the left.
tips.is: Very expensive. Northern lights September–April, midnight sun in June. Showering before geothermal pools is mandatory.
tips.no: Outside the EU but in Schengen. Card payment everywhere, very expensive. Midnight sun in the north.
tips.se: Nearly cashless. The right of public access (allemansrätten) allows free camping under conditions.
tips.fi: Sauna is part of daily life. Northern lights in Lapland. Tipping is not expected.
tips.dk: Danish krone (not the euro). Bike lanes everywhere. Service is included.
tips.ee: Digital pioneer (e-Residency), free Wi-Fi everywhere. UNESCO-listed medieval old town.
tips.lv: Riga is rich in Art Nouveau. Jāņi (solstice) festivities on 23–24 June.
tips.lt: Curonian Spit is UNESCO-listed. Užupis is a self-proclaimed 'republic' district.
tips.fr: Outside big cities, restaurants close between services. Transport strikes are frequent: check ahead.
tips.de: Cash is still widely used. Shops closed on Sundays. Bottle deposits (Pfand) apply.
tips.nl: Never walk on cycle paths. Debit cards are the norm; some places refuse cash.
tips.be: Three official languages: Dutch, French, German. Trappist beers and fries in a cone.
tips.lu: Public transport is free nationwide since 2020. Three official languages.
tips.mc: A 2 km² city-state with no visible border. Smart dress required at the casino. Grand Prix in May.
tips.li: Doubly landlocked. Swiss franc. A souvenir passport stamp is available at the tourist office.
tips.ch: Swiss franc (not the euro), very expensive. Outside the EU but in Schengen. Highly punctual transport.
tips.at: A motorway vignette is mandatory. Viennese coffee houses are on UNESCO's heritage list.
tips.pl: Złoty (not the euro). 'Milk bars' (bar mleczny) serve very cheap meals.
tips.cz: Czech koruna. Avoid central Prague exchange offices: use an ATM instead.
tips.sk: High Tatras and many castles. Electronic vignette for motorways.
tips.hu: Forint (not the euro). Thermal baths in Budapest. Withdraw in forints, not euros, at ATMs.
tips.si: Motorway vignette mandatory. Lake Bled; very green and safe.
tips.ru: Visa needed for most visitors. Foreign bank cards do not work. Many governments advise against travel: check advisories.
tips.ua: Country at war: population figure very uncertain. Travel strongly discouraged; check official advisories.
tips.by: Check official advisories: entry rules and the political situation change. Cyrillic alphabet.
tips.md: Transnistria: breakaway region with its own checks, discouraged. Cricova wine cellars.
tips.ro: Romanian leu (not the euro). Full Schengen member since 1 January 2025. Transylvania and its castles.
tips.bg: Euro adopted on 1 January 2026. Schengen member since 2025. Black Sea coast and rakia.
tips.ge: Supra (feast) and qvevri wine. Abkhazia and South Ossetia: breakaway regions, discouraged.
tips.am: Unique alphabet. Land borders with Türkiye and Azerbaijan: check their status.
tips.az: E-visa (ASAN) for many nationalities. Check the Armenian border. Mined areas in the former Nagorno-Karabakh.
tips.es: Late schedules: lunch around 2pm, dinner around 9pm. The Canary Islands are on UTC+0/+1.
tips.pt: Electronic tolls on some motorways: ask the rental firm for a device. Azores and Madeira are separate trips.
tips.it: The 'coperto' (cover charge) is billed. ZTL zones in historic centres cause fines.
tips.mt: Drive on the left. Maltese and English are official. Very dense: everything is close by.
tips.va: World's smallest state. Shoulders and knees must be covered. Book museums and basilica.
tips.sm: Enclaved in Italy, no border checks. Oldest republic in the world, UNESCO-listed.
tips.ad: Uses the euro outside the EU. Tax-free shopping, skiing and spas. Customs checks at the borders.
tips.gr: Ferries are sometimes cancelled by summer winds (meltemi). In many toilets, paper goes in the bin.
tips.al: Lek (euros accepted in tourist areas). Communist-era bunkers everywhere, Albanian Riviera.
tips.mk: Denar. Lake Ohrid is UNESCO-listed. Skopje is dotted with recent statues.
tips.me: Uses the euro without being in the eurozone. Bay of Kotor and Durmitor.
tips.rs: Serbian dinar. Cyrillic and Latin scripts. Entering Serbia from Kosovo can be problematic: check.
tips.ba: Convertible mark. Mostar bridge. Residual landmines off marked paths.
tips.hr: Euro and Schengen since 2023. Book island ferries in summer.
tips.xk: Recognised by only some states. Euro. See official advice on crossings via Serbia.
tips.cy: Drive on the left. Island divided by the Green Line: crossing in Nicosia with a passport.
tips.tr: High inflation: tourist prices sometimes in euros. Outside Schengen. Istanbul is the largest city.
